summary: Under the conservation category, the Philippines commits to a 75% net emissions reduction and/or avoidance target, including FOLU, for 2025–2035 against projected business-as-usual cumulative emissions. The pledge comprises 7% unconditional reductions or avoidance and 68% conditional upon international support, and it also seeks to maximize the potential of the sink over the NDC period and beyond. This is an emissions-and-sink commitment rather than a stated hectare, reforestation, or protected-area target. For geographical perspective, forest covers 105,291 km², or 35.7% of the country, while agriculture covers 178,092 km², or 60.5%; because the passage specifies no land area, the pledge cannot be quantified as a share of either class.

targets.metric: Net emissions reduction and/or avoidance (including FOLU; 7% unconditional and 68% conditional)
targets.context: No land-area allocation is specified; forest covers 35.7% and agriculture 60.5% of current land area.
